calls.title: AGS and GrowthBook
calls.summary: Gabe, from AGS's physical table products division, explained the pain point of limited data access from casino systems. Scott Keller and Logan Bates (GrowthBook) clarified their digital experimentation platform doesn't fit this use case. Next step: GrowthBook will reach out to Zoe Eberling, head of AGS's digital division, as a potential prospect.
